Challenges We Solve

Rapid Ruby Team Scaling 

Do you urgently need to expand your Ruby on Rails developers team, speed-start a new project, or quickly fill a skill / technology gap? Mobilunity will hire top Ruby developers for you within a few weeks. We’re here to help you accelerate development and meet even aggressive deadlines.

Hiring Rails Developers Cost-Effectively 

If the cost to hire developers locally is pretty high, we’ll help you find the best remote Ruby on Rails developers from top IT hubs worldwide with up to 50% cost savings. We’ll also ensure your candidate fits your working culture.

Delivering Complex Solutions for Diverse Industries

Our software development experts bring innovative technologies to e-commerce, SaaS, digital marketing, online media, and other industries. The full-stack Ruby coders you hire with us create web apps that have optimized architecture and offer exceptional user experience.

Need for Ruby on Rails Expertise

When you’re looking to hire Ruby experts to cover knowledge gaps within your in-house team, the best staffing solution is to hire Rails developers from us part-time. This way, you’ll get high-quality deliverables and achieve project goals flexibly, in time, and cost-effectively.

Maintaining High Product Quality

Hiring a Ruby developer involves further maintenance and support of your web or mobile app. Every developer must also deliver high-quality code and be able to spot and fix issues promptly. This is exactly what our developers can do for you, taking care of your project like in-house employees.

Building Multinational Ruby Teams

Do you need Ruby on Rails developers for hire in several countries? Our recruiters can have developers available immediately or find Ruby developers for hire in almost any part of the world, including Europe, North America, LATAM, the Middle East, Asia, etc.

Services Offered by Ruby on Rails Developers

Web Development

Mobilunity’s web developers have in-depth knowledge of Ruby and excel at crafting robust and scalable web applications using Ruby on Rails. With a keen eye for user experience and a commitment to best practices, they’ll bring your project to life and ensure it’ll stand out in the digital landscape.

RoR Cloud Hosting & Migration

When you get Ruby on Rails developers with Mobilunity, you can trust our experts to migrate your application to the cloud. They specialize in optimizing performance and security while minimizing downtime. So, your app transition to cloud hosting will be a smooth process.

Maintenance & Support

Our top remote Ruby developers offer round-the-clock maintenance and support services to keep your web applications running flawlessly. Whether it’s bug fixes, updates, or enhancements, employ a team of Ruby coders to ensure your digital presence remains top-notch.

Unit Testing & Integration

Mobilunity’s remote Ruby on Rails developers rigorously check your application’s components’ functionality and interactions. Relying on top testing frameworks, our coders ensure the stability, reliability, and functionality of your RoR applications across various platforms, browsers, and devices.

Consulting Services

Leverage our RoR consulting expertise to optimize your existing projects or strategize new ones. Whether you work in SaaS, e-commerce, digital marketing, or other industries, Mobilunity’s on-demand experts will provide invaluable insights. They’ll help you design solution architecture, select an optimal tech stack, optimize app performance, or manage the project so that you can focus on driving your business forward.

Integration & Extension

Once you need to integrate third-party services or extend the functionality of your Ruby on Rails application, we can help. With Mobilunity, within weeks you’ll get the right Ruby developer to add external services to your product. Our engineers are adept at adding APIs, plugins, and extensions. They enable your software to evolve and allow you to meet the market’s changing needs.

API Development & Integration

Ruby’s modularity and scalability allow developers to build easily maintainable and efficient programming interfaces. So, when you get Ruby on Rails experts through Mobilunity, it’s easy to pack your app with the functionalities of external tools. Your data will stay protected due to regular vulnerability reviews and robust security policies.

E-commerce Solutions

Ruby on Rails supports the MVC (Model-View-Controller) structure, which makes it ideal for creating online shops. The independent components improve the security and maintenance of your app, while RubyGems makes your e-commerce platform quickly scalable. You’ll take advantage of all these benefits by employing an expert from us.

CMS Development

Mobilunity’s RoR coders will analyze your requirements and deliver a content management system with needed-only functionalities. We’ll get experienced engineers who’ll use Ruby’s pre-built elements to develop a flexible, scalable, and secure instrument to structure, publish, and improve your content.

Custom Software Development

Whether you want to build an e-shop, livestream service, data analytics platform, or any other app, Ruby has the ecosystem to meet your needs. Our experienced Ruby on Rails developers explore your requirements and discuss possible solutions. So, your product gets the features that your audience loves. 

Code Audit & Optimization

The source code of your Rails application must ensure its stability, security, and readiness for extension. Mobilunity will find tech experts with proficiency in the Ruby programming language to assess your app’s entire ecosystem. Senior developers review your code with automation tools and analyze it manually. This way, they check the business logic and detect vulnerabilities, bottlenecks, incorrect design patterns, etc.

Database Design & Management

The optimized structure of data boosts the performance and security of your Ruby on Rails app. You can hire a Ruby developer to create a new-brand or improve your application with popular RoR databases like PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MySQL. With these top technologies, our coders will help you simplify data management even in complex projects and e-commerce platforms.

MVP Development

Startups can benefit from MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development when they get Ruby on Rails programmers with Mobilunity. This technology allows for fast and cost-effective app development and easy maintenance. It’s possible because this technology follows the MVC architectural approach, has templates, and boasts its own testing tool. And with our access to a global talent pool, we’ll find you a skilled developer that doesn’t cost a fortune.

FAQs About Hiring Ruby on Rails Developers

Can you hire Ruby programmers for short-term projects?

Yes. You can hire the best freelance Ruby developers with us for 3-12 months. We offer flexible options like hourly (several hours a week) or part-time (up to 20 hours a week) cooperation. If your project’s timeline is 6+ months, hiring a Ruby on Rails coder or a team of developers full-time is also possible.

Can your team help with technical interviews?

Yes, in contrast to a classic Ruby on Rails development company, Mobilunity offers technical interviewing as a service. If you need tech expertise as part of our Recruiting-as-a-Service or Team Augmentation pack, you’ll pay a monthly fee for an unlimited number of interviews. Otherwise, we can arrange technical interviews with your top Rails developers for hire for a fixed per-interview fee.

What’s the cost to hire skilled Ruby on Rails developers?

The cost will depend on the country where the engineer is based, their seniority, and the hiring format. Schedule a free consultation to estimate the cost of hiring your team.

How quickly can you hire a Ruby developer?

The timeline often depends on the market situation and the client’s feedback. However, the Ruby on Rails community is quite big, it usually takes about 4-6 weeks to hire the best remote Ruby developer. You can expect to get the first CVs within a week and schedule interviews during weeks 2-4.

Is it possible to use Ruby on Rails for AI-based solutions?

Though you can add some AI-powered modules with specific gems (pre-written codes) like ai4r and sciruby, this language isn’t the best choice for AI. Python, for instance, has large ML libraries and offers high speed for processing resource-intensive ML tasks. However, once you need to incorporate AI components, we can hire senior and proven Java, Python, or Scala developers.

Can I scale my Ruby on Rails application as my business grows?

Indeed, Ruby on Rails is recognized for its ability to scale. With the proper design, it can manage heightened traffic and an expanding user population. Our team of skilled Ruby developers create applications focused on scalability, guaranteeing they can expand with your business requirements and adjust to new obstacles as your project progresses.

What is the typical team structure for a Ruby on Rails project?

The organization of a Ruby on Rails development team may differ based on the complexity of the project. Generally, a team consists of a lead developer, backend and frontend developers, a UI/UX designer, and a project manager. If necessary, we can also add QA testers, business analysts, and DevOps engineers to guarantee the seamless execution of the project.

What are the advantages of hiring vetted Ruby on Rails developers from Mobilunity?

By hiring developers from Mobilunity, you gain access to a dedicated group of specialists with substantial expertise in creating secure, high-quality, and scalable web applications. We offer adaptable employment options, clear pricing, and tailored assistance to cater to your project’s unique requirements. Our developers keep current with the newest trends, guaranteeing that your application employs the finest tools and technologies.
